Prepare step by step

  1. Identify the government notice, tax type, business or household task without entering account numbers here.
  2. Record dates shown by the original source exactly and verify deadlines, balances and filing instructions with the responsible office or agency.
  3. Ask professionals about credentials, scope, conflicts, fees, data security and who will perform the work.
  4. Do not send tax records, identity documents, bank details or passwords through an unverified channel.

General preparation and help finding the right source only—not tax, accounting, financial, insurance or investment advice; this site does not calculate deadlines or balances.
